pkgmetadata.longdescription: Nimbalyst is an Electron-based visual workspace for the Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode coding agents. It lets you run multiple agents in parallel and edit their work visually in markdown, mockups, and diagrams, with built-in task tracking. Nimbalyst's own code is MIT-licensed, but the packaged binary bundles a proprietary (all-rights-reserved) copy of Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK/CLI alongside it; see LICENSE for details.
